description: This Java class 'MenuFactory' provides methods to load and retrieve menu configurations from XML files, either from web application resources or from specified locations, and caches these menus for efficient access.

classes.name: MenuFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading and caching menu models from XML resources, supporting retrieval from web app context or specific locations.

methods.name: getMenuFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object from the web application context, loading and caching the menu XML if necessary.

methods.name: readMenuDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to construct a map of menu names to ModelMenu objects.

methods.name: getMenuFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object from a specified location, loading and caching the menu XML if necessary.
